instruction: Access the FlightAware discussions forum and navigate to the 'Commercial Aviation' section to view active topics.

metadata.explanation: Variation navigates to Commercial Aviation category. Uses same pattern matching approach as variations 1-2. Maintains consistent difficulty with different target category.

The metric is_expected_url_pattern_match correctly performs regex pattern matching against the constructed URL
The expected pattern 'https://discussions\.flightaware\.com/c/commercial-aviation/' correctly matches the target URL format
Evaluator can successfully verify when user navigates to the FlightAware Commercial Aviation discussions section
Complete coverage: The single requirement in the instruction (navigate to Commercial Aviation section) is fully verified by checking the active tab URL
